OET-SPEAKING
01)Different types of patients

New pt-
Good afternoon 
My names Dr
I’m your treating doctor today
How can I help you? 

Old Pt
Good afternoon 
Nice to see you again Mr Smith
Thank you for coming to see me
What can I do for you today/ what brought you in today?

Already examined pt
Well… thank you for letting me examine you.
According to the examination findings… 

Doc late to attend to pt
Good afternoon Mr Smith
Please take a seat.
I’m so/extremely sorry for making you wait. We have been so busy here today.

2)Empathy
 I’m so sorry to hear that.
I appreciate your worries/ concerns,

3) Permission to question further!
But let me ask you some questions first, if you don’t mind.
If you don’t mind, can I ask you some questions first?

4) Make patient comfortable 
Please let me know if your feel uncomfortable at anytime.

5) Clarify-
 Ask about the symptoms patient says.

-Could you describe the pain? Where is the pain? 
-How often do you get…?
-How long have you had it? 
-What brings on an attack?
-What about your/the child’s appetite?
Are you/ is he eating well?

Ending this part-
@Have you taken any medication for it?
@Is there anything else that’s bothering you? 

6) Consent for examination 
May I examine you now please?
Thank you.

7) Explain the diagnosis
Based on your history and after the examination, I believe that you have what is called ….
Have you heard that before?
Let me explain.

8) Investigations 
We will run some blood tests and get a urine sample and refer you for an x ray.
Does that sound good so far?

Alright then I will book you for a review appointment in two weeks time

9) Treatment
I think we could start with .....
I will give you a prescription for .....
I will refer you ......

I see that it must have been a very difficult situation for you. But the good news is that there are several options available which could help you. Do you want me to continue explaining?

10) Reassure
@Let me reassure you that eczema is self limiting.
@ Don’t worry it will go away by itself in a few days. You’ll need to rest though.
@ I know it sounds difficult at first. But with time and practice you will improve 
@Well, let’s not worry about this at the moment
@ The staff here is very experienced and will take good care of you.
Just remember/keep in mind that you’re in good hands.

11) Advice
I’m concerned about your smoking habit.
I strongly advise/ recommend .....

Do you think you could may be...?
Perhaps you could try….

@reluctant patient 
I can understand your worries
But please be ensured that you can share your feelings with me so that I can treat you better, as a whole

@Busy patient 
Well I understand that you’re busy
But for me the priority is to health
So I would strongly advise you to 

@Resistant patient 
Well let me explain to you why it’s important to stop smoking.
You will have less risk of developing heart disease later if you stick to my advices. 
But if you continue to smoke then the risk would be much higher.
You don’t want that to happen, do you?

@ Insisting on treatment
Well let me explain why sleeping pills are not a good choice for you right now. If you get used to them you will become dependent which means you won’t be able to sleep without them.
I would prefer alternatives

I understand but let me explain to you why you shouldn’t be doing it anymore

12) checking understanding 
Well, are we good so far?? ☺️

Is everything clear?

Am I clear so far?

Do you have any questions so far?

13) end

Do you have any more questions?
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Well thank you then. I hope you/your son feel(s) better soon.
Wish you a speedy recovery.

Do come if symptoms don’t resolve alright?

Sum up- Just be sure to stick to our management plan. 

14) Breaking bad news
We have the test results back but I’m so sorry to tell you that / unfortunately it’s not good news I’m afraid.

The cause of your symptoms could ....

It’s very important that we do a few further tests .

We will keep a close eye on you to make sure that you’re in good hands.

Do you have anybody to talk to? Or perhaps who could support you?
